Name: Landing zone subscription deployment operator (<scope-name>)
Description: Least-privilege subscription-scope orchestration for the Foundation UAMI. Allows reading subscription metadata, checking resource-provider registration, and creating, validating and what-if-ing ARM deployments. It grants no resource write, delete, deployment cancel, provider registration, or role-assignment rights; those come from resource-group-scoped Contributor and Role Based Access Control Administrator assignments.
